item.title: Judge | Ashoka University's Shatranj 3.0 — Where Business Strategy meets Technology
item.description: Sometimes, stepping outside your area of expertise offers the most interesting learning experiences. I recently had the opportunity to join Monopoly: Joint Strategic Ventures, a flagship business simulation and strategy competition at Shatranj 3.0, Ashoka University’s Entrepreneurship Weekender, held on Oct 31 - Nov 1, 2026, at its Sonepat campus. I joined the competition as a judge, bringing my technology and engineering leadership experience to a competition centred on business strategy, partnerships, and joint ventures.

item.title: Judge - Ashoka University Hackathon 2022
item.description: RedBrick Hacks is flagship summer hackathon of Ashoka University, open to students from Delhi NCR. You will have the opportunity to learn, collaborate, and build meaningful projects alongside mentors from various disciplines. For 24 hours on the weekend of June 18, you will have access to free workshops, plenary lectures, prizes worth over ₹8L, games, and more! The theme of the event was “Tech for Social Good” with three main tracks: Health & Wellness, Sustainable Growth, and Security & Privacy.
